overview: This 570-page file combines a September 1945 survey of Japanese fisheries with a July 1945 guide to administering production in occupied Japan. The fisheries report covers resources, vessels, processing, trade, regulation, wartime shortages, and restoration. The production guide, which appears twice, documents wartime economic controls and proposes how military government could administer them.
interest: Detailed fisheries statistics and translated control laws show what occupation planners knew and how they intended to govern production.
